content: ललामन् {%a.%} [लल्-इमनिन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 162</ls>, <ls n="Uṇ. 4.">164</ls>] .²1 An ornament, a decoration. .²2 (Hence) Anything the best of its kind; कन्याललाम कमनीयमजस्य लिप्सोः <ls>R. 5. 64</ls> ‘the best or ornament of girls’. .²3 A banner, flag. .²4 A sectarial mark, token, sign, symbol. .²5 A tail. .²6 A species of stanza (having 10 syllables in the first two Pādas, 11 in the third and 13 in the fourth); see ललाम.
